hero.title.value: OpenAI-powered event shopping assistant for RetailNext.

hero.body.value: A natural language assistant that helps shoppers describe what they need, checks real inventory, and carries the journey into web, app, WhatsApp, associate, and email follow-up channels.

hero.proof.0.body.value: customers ask in natural language or share a photo

hero.proof.1.body.value: SKU, store, size, and price checked before display

hero.proof.2.body.value: same assistant pattern across site, app, WhatsApp, store, and email follow-up

situation.impact.1.body.value: associates bridge style, stock, substitutes, and customer messaging

situation.impact.2.body.value: poor reviews compound when store discovery falls short of the digital promise

situation.heading.value: Event shoppers struggle to find or confirm the right items quickly.

situation.body.value: Reviews point to the same issue: discovery, availability, and store confidence are split across the journey.

searchGap.heading.value: The interface matters: chat captures more of the buying mission.

searchGap.body.value: Customers are more likely to engage when they can explain the occasion in their own words.

solution.heading.value: An inventory-grounded AI assistant for event shopping.

solution.body.value: OpenAI interprets text, images, and follow-up chat. RetailNext verifies products, stock, price, and fulfilment.

demoBridge.heading.value: The chatbot pattern can sit wherever customers already shop.

demoBridge.body.value: One assistant workflow can serve the website, mobile app, WhatsApp, associates, and lifecycle messaging.

sequence.body.value: The boundary is simple: OpenAI interprets and explains; RetailNext validates what can be shown and sold.

architecture.body.value: Click through the flow to show the OpenAI and RetailNext boundary.

platform.heading.value: OpenAI is the platform layer for the assistant loop.

platform.body.value: Multimodal understanding, structured outputs, embeddings, model choice, tool actions, and evals work together in one pattern.

value.body.value: Use the value toggle to connect OpenAI capabilities to measurable retail outcomes.

rollout.body.value: Prove engagement first, then integrate operations and expand channels.

situation.problems.0.body.value: "I need something for a winter wedding" is a better brief than "black dress".

situation.problems.1.body.value: Customers and associates still need to confirm store, size, substitutes, and timing.

situation.problems.2.body.value: Event shoppers have urgency, higher basket potential, and lower tolerance for failed searches.

solution.roleCards.0.body.value: Intent extraction, image understanding, semantic retrieval inputs, action selection, explanations, and review.

solution.roleCards.1.body.value: Catalogue SKUs, price, stock, store rules, basket changes, fulfilment, and email delivery.

sequence.steps.0.body.value: Occasion, image, store, budget, style, urgency.

sequence.steps.1.body.value: Store, size, budget, timing, starter-product context.

sequence.steps.2.body.value: GPT-4o mini returns attributes, outfit roles, and search phrases.

sequence.steps.3.body.value: Embeddings match the event brief to catalogue vectors.

sequence.steps.4.body.value: Stock, budget, urgency, outfit role, colour, event fit.

sequence.steps.5.body.value: OpenAI writes rationale and reviews the actual basket.

value.metrics.1.body.value: Natural language lowers the effort to start.

value.metrics.3.body.value: Associates get item rationale and backup options.

rollout.timeline.0.body.value: Text assistant, limited categories, selected stores, static inventory snapshot.

rollout.timeline.1.body.value: Photo input, real-time inventory, guardrail tuning, WhatsApp pilot.

rollout.timeline.2.body.value: Associate assistant, email recovery, personalisation, continuous eval loop.

searchGap.core.body.value: OpenAI gives RetailNext a conversational front door for product discovery and a structured bridge into retail systems.

value.scorecard.body.value: Measure product engagement, add-to-basket, availability-related complaints, associate lookup time, and recovery engagement.

sequence.boundary.body.value: OpenAI never becomes the source of product truth. RetailNext owns catalogue data, price, stock, basket state, and fulfilment rules.

rollout.closing.body.value: "Start with the customer conversation, ground it in RetailNext inventory, and measure the commercial journey end to end."

architecture.boundary.0.item.4.value: Grounded generation for shopper and associate copy

architecture.boundary.1.item.1.value: Catalogue, product images, prices, and inventory

architecture.boundary.1.item.2.value: Budget, availability, substitutes, and fulfilment rules

architecture.boundary.1.item.4.value: Business KPIs, channel deployment, and email handoff

keyword.label: Keyword search
keyword.title: Black dress
keyword.output: Product matches, then manual checks for event fit, size, store, and substitutes.
keyword.value: Useful for known-item search, weaker for event-led discovery.

chat.label: Natural language chat
chat.title: Smart outfit for a winter wedding in New York
chat.input: I need a smart outfit for a winter wedding in New York, available near me today.
chat.output: OpenAI extracts occasion, formality, weather, urgency, budget, store, and outfit roles.
chat.value: Customers can describe the mission naturally, which makes the assistant easier to engage with.

photo.label: Photo + chat
photo.title: Build around this jacket
photo.input: I like this jacket. Can you build an outfit for a work dinner?
photo.output: Vision identifies style cues, then the assistant retrieves compatible products and checks availability.
photo.value: A customer can start from inspiration, not taxonomy.

whatsapp.label: WhatsApp prompt
whatsapp.title: Same assistant, lower-friction channel
whatsapp.input: Need an outfit for a wedding tomorrow. Can I collect it at Oxford Street?
whatsapp.output: The same structured assistant flow can respond in a messaging channel and hand off to store or email follow-up.
whatsapp.value: RetailNext can meet customers where they already communicate.

web.title: Website and app
web.job: Make product discovery conversational without replacing the existing commerce journey.
web.enabler: OpenAI maps natural language and images into structured search and action requests.
web.outcome: Higher engagement, clearer baskets, and a route into checkout.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp
whatsapp.job: Support urgent event shopping in a channel customers already use.
whatsapp.enabler: The same intent extraction and action schema can sit behind a messaging experience.
whatsapp.outcome: Lower-friction re-engagement, store collection prompts, and recovery journeys.

associate.title: Associate tool
associate.job: Give store teams the outfit rationale, stock risks, and substitute options.
associate.enabler: Grounded generation summarises verified product and inventory facts.
associate.outcome: Less manual lookup and a better handoff from digital to store.

email.title: Email follow-up
email.job: Turn the session into a timely lifecycle message.
email.enabler: Structured outputs provide product, event, stock, and copy fields for email payloads.
email.outcome: Abandoned missions can support personalised follow-up and recovery.

intent.title: Mission capture
intent.body: A shopper starts from chat, product, or image, then adds occasion, store, budget, and urgency.
intent.value: The assistant captures a richer brief than a keyword box.

understand.title: Intent understanding
understand.body: OpenAI extracts item type, colour, formality, constraints, and outfit roles.
understand.value: Text and images become structured fields the app can validate.

retrieve.title: Semantic retrieval
retrieve.body: Embeddings match the shopping brief to catalogue vectors.
retrieve.value: RetailNext can retrieve by meaning, not only by exact product terms.

ground.title: Retail validation
ground.body: RetailNext applies stock, price, size, budget, urgency, and fulfilment rules.
ground.value: Only validated products reach the customer.

activate.title: Actions and handoff
activate.body: The assistant explains, swaps, emails, briefs associates, and flags demand gaps.
activate.value: One conversation becomes checkout support, store handoff, and email follow-up.

vision.title: Multimodal understanding
vision.headline: Production-quality text and image reasoning.
vision.use: Reads occasion prompts and starter-item photos.
vision.value: Customers can begin with natural language, a product, or inspiration.

structured.title: Structured Outputs
structured.headline: Reliable API contracts for retail systems.
structured.use: Returns strict fields for occasion, outfit slots, budget, urgency, store, and constraints.
structured.value: RetailNext can validate, log, test, and route model output.

embeddings.title: Embeddings
embeddings.headline: Semantic retrieval over a large catalogue.
embeddings.use: Matches the event brief to products by meaning.
embeddings.value: Improves discovery when the customer uses everyday language.

ladder.title: Model ladder
ladder.headline: Right model for each task.
ladder.use: Fast model for intent, embeddings for retrieval, stronger model for review and copy.
ladder.value: Balances quality, latency, and cost as traffic scales.

tools.title: Tool actions
tools.headline: Chat requests become controlled operations.
tools.use: Mira maps 'swap the shoes' or 'email this outfit' to previewed actions.
tools.value: Conversation can move the journey forward without bypassing app checks.

evals.title: Evals
evals.headline: Quality checks before scale.
evals.use: Test event fit, availability truth, substitutions, latency, cost, and refusal paths.
evals.value: RetailNext gets a route from demo to governed production.

enterprise.title: Enterprise controls
enterprise.headline: Data and system control remain with RetailNext.
enterprise.use: OpenAI supports interpretation and language; RetailNext owns product truth and actions.
enterprise.value: The model helps the journey without owning commercial decisions.

conversion.title: Increase high-intent event conversion
conversion.goal: Move shoppers from vague occasion to available basket.
conversion.metric: Product click-through, add-to-cart, revenue per event visit.

friction.title: Reduce availability-driven friction
friction.goal: Stop showing attractive options that fail at store or size level.
friction.metric: Availability-related complaints, failed searches, collection confidence.

efficiency.title: Improve store-level efficiency
efficiency.goal: Give associates context before the customer arrives.
efficiency.enabler: Generated handoff notes grounded in verified products.
efficiency.metric: Associate lookup time, substitute acceptance, in-store conversion.

learning.title: Create a demand learning loop
learning.goal: Capture unmet event intent and stock gaps.
learning.enabler: Structured outputs + email and reporting payloads.
learning.metric: Missed-demand themes, replenishment signals, recovery engagement.
